question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Guage**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Guage**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Gauge**'. • It means** 'an instrument for measuring the amount of something'.** (किसी वस्‍तु की मात्रा मापने का उपकरण; पैमाना) • *Example: a fuel/temperature/pressure **gauge**...* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Caution**: great** **care, because of possible danger. (विशेष सावधानी, सतर्कता, चौकसी) • **Thrive**: to grow or develop well. (सफलतापूर्वक बढ़ना या विकसित होना, फलना-फूलना) • **Relish**: to enjoy something or to look forward to something very much. (किसी वस्‍तु का आनंद लेना या किसी बात की उत्‍सुकता से प्रतीक्षा करना) aa:T9ec, The correct answer is '**Pliable**'.
